# Font APEX attribution

Font APEX is the icon library from the Oracle APEX team, used by Oracle APEX Universal Theme. The application uses its iconography; the five application-icon PNG sizes were generated by APEX from its icon library.

## Source and licence

- Upstream project: https://github.com/oracle/font-apex
- Notice source commit: `24631d9cc7ebb23ccc58bc676343d288bf453a62`
- Retained upstream licence: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)
- Original notice URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oracle/font-apex/24631d9cc7ebb23ccc58bc676343d288bf453a62/LICENSE.txt
- Retained notice SHA-256 (UTF-8, LF): `4b68767f618e57459a3029f9e88bb0d595232e00d2cd320c543514537017e69a`

The upstream project identifies **icons and code as MIT-licensed** and **fonts as SIL OFL 1.1**. The complete upstream notice is retained without editing its legal text. Font APEX itself remains credited to the Oracle APEX team; this project does not claim authorship of its icon artwork.

## Material distributed here

On dev, the generated PNG files are under `apex/application/shared-components/static-files/icons/`:

- `app-icon-32.png`
- `app-icon-144-rounded.png`
- `app-icon-192.png`
- `app-icon-256-rounded.png`
- `app-icon-512.png`

The APEX SQL export on both branches embeds those application-icon images. The release Worksheet installer also contains that export. Separate PNG source files are omitted from the release tree, but the artwork is still included in those SQL artifacts.

The Font APEX font files and the Oracle APEX/Universal Theme runtime libraries are not bundled in this repository; the target APEX service supplies them. The retained font notice documents the upstream library's licensing split and does not imply that font binaries are distributed here.

These third-party assets retain their applicable upstream terms. The project's root UPL notice does not replace them. When redistributing the application export or installer separately, include the project NOTICE and this retained licence notice alongside it.
